versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-google-images.

- Adds a skill to handle user requests to search Google Images and route them through the Dataify Scraper API.
- Implements a strict pre-call confirmation workflow, requiring user review and parameter confirmation using a generated Markdown table.
- Enforces documented default values only, never using undocumented or example values as defaults.
- Guides collecting all required parameters before submitting an API call, with prompts if mandatory fields are missing.
- Uses a bundled Python script to build and send the form-data request; outputs the raw API response to the user.
- Includes clear instructions for handling user tokens and enforcing field mapping rules for all supported search parameters.
